fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 27% match is a WEAK FIT for this Customer Success Manager role.

**Strengths:**
- Basic Python with pandas supports the usage trend analysis duties
- Head of Year 9 shows relationship management with students and parents
- Workshop facilitation and one-to-one coaching translate to customer onboarding

**Gaps:**
- No 5-7 years in a customer account facing role
- No sales experience: negotiation, up-selling, cross-selling, full sales cycle
- No MEDDIC or Command of the Message methodology exposure

**Recommendation:** Build experience first in an entry-level customer success or onboarding role at a tech company, then reapply to Datadog.

coverLetter:
Daniel Okafor
Leeds, UK
daniel.okafor@example.org
+44 20 5550 0188

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your ad describes a Customer Success Manager who has to build mutual trust with customers while spotting usage trends that signal renewal risk. I know the same tension from teaching: I run weekly parent calls for a year group of 210 students, and the calls only work when the relationship is strong enough to hear bad news early.

I'm a physics teacher and Head of Year 9 at Ashgrove Academy, and I'd be making a career change, so I won't pretend to have a customer account background. What I do have transfers directly. I raised the share of Year 11 students reaching grade 5 or above from 71% to 86% over three years by tracking progress in Excel and Google Sheets and presenting results to senior leadership each term. That is usage-trend thinking applied to students. I also wrote a Year 9 practical curriculum and trained 12 colleagues to use it, which is onboarding adults to something new. I'm working through the Google Data Analytics Certificate and completed Python for Everybody on Coursera, so the technology side of Datadog's platform is something I'm keen to grow into.

Your ad says you welcome people who want to grow their experience, and I'd like to do that in Boston with your hybrid team, alongside Support, Product, Finance and Legal. I'm available for a conversation at your convenience and can talk through how I'd approach the first 90 days.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Customer Success Manager, Daniel Okafor
applicationEmail.body:
Dear Datadog Hiring Team,

For eight years I've built trust with families as a teacher, including weekly parent calls and two parents' evenings a term for a year group of 210 students, and I'd like to bring that relationship building to your customers. I've also trained 12 colleagues to use a curriculum I wrote, so I know how to onboard people clearly and keep them confident. My CV and cover letter are attached for you to look through. I'm available for a call any weekday after 4pm UK time, and I can start a conversation about notice period whenever suits you.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

I would welcome the chance to discuss how I could contribute.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor
